human_repair_overrides.content: Merge each strain's Dn pathways into its Up set. Add these Dn pathways: strain 97 gets Quorum sensing, Phenazine biosynthesis, Nitrogen cycle, and Biosynthesis of secondary metabolites; strain 98 gets Two-component system, Starch and sucrose metabolism, Nitrogen cycle, and Biosynthesis of secondary metabolites; strain 99 gets Two-component system, Starch and sucrose metabolism, Quorum sensing, Phenazine biosynthesis, Nitrogen cycle, Biosynthesis of secondary metabolites, Biofilm formation - Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Bacterial chemotaxis.
